verdict.rationale: Bevy documents both an in-depth reference with inline examples (bevy-docs-27) and a separate interactive examples gallery that runs directly in the browser via WASM (bevy-docs-16, bevy-docs-34, bevy-docs-22), giving strong 'runnable examples' support, but these are two distinct systems rather than a unified interactive API reference where you browse the API and run examples together. Missing for 10: a single integrated experience combining API docs with inline runnable code, and any AI-native tooling (llms.txt, structured API export) confirmed absent by probes (bevy-probe-1, bevy-probe-3).
